ha_base_url.title: Home Assistant address
ha_base_url.description: Complete HTTP(S) address, including any port or path prefix. Credentials, query strings and fragments are not supported.

watch_entities.title: Entities to watch
watch_entities.description: Up to 32 entity IDs separated by commas or newlines. Leave blank to show connection status only.

ha_token.title: Home Assistant token
ha_token.description: Required token for this plugin. The worker only reads, but the token retains its Home Assistant account permissions.
